newsitem.title: Canada: Canadian dollar rallies to close near C$1.3300.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar rallies to close near C$1.3300.

text.p: FORECAST RANGE 1.3200/1.3350 ASIAN CLOSE 1.3359
RESISTANCE 1.3280 SUPPORT 1.3350 HI 1.3370 LO 1.3361
CANADA OPEN 1.3364/69 HI 1.3370 EUROPE OPEN 1.3360
* The Canadian dollar rallied to close at C$1.3301 (US$0.7518)
after breaching the key resistance level of C$1.3300
(US$0.7519) in late trade after a volatile session. * Analysts
said strength in the currency driven by strong buying of
Canadian bonds and techical momentum. * The unit strengthened
to its highest levels since October 30, 1995.
Canada's dollar closed at its strongest level in more than a year on Tuesday, ending at C$1.3301 (US$0.7518).
The strong close came after the unit traded at its highest level since last year's Quebec sovereignty referendum. The currency breached the key resistance level of C$1.3300 (US$0.7519) in late trade.
The currency rallied amid strong U.S. interest in Canadian bonds and bullish technical momentum, dealers said.
"There's a very strong bond market. I think it's responsible for the strength in the Canadian dollar, the continuation in the trend," said one Toronto-based dealer.
Canadian bonds closed much stronger on Tuesday, sharply outperforming U.S. Treasuries amid buying by U.S. hedge funds, dealers said.

Analysts had predicted strong bullish momentum if the currency made a firm move past C$1.3333 (US$0.7500). The unit briefly passed the key resistance level Monday. Analysts said the next key resistance level was C$1.3280 (US$0.7530).
In other news, Canadian foreign reserve holdings rose to US$20.029 billion from US$19.493 billion during October, the Finance Department said.
On the crosses, the Canada strengthened to 1.1410 marks from Monday's close of 1.1300 marks and firmed to 85.75 yen from 85.17 yen.
